seoText: Generate RFC 4122 compliant 128-bit UUID v4 strings for database keys, session IDs, and tracking tokens with cryptographic randomness.

faq.a: The probability of a duplicate UUID v4 is virtually zero (1 in 2^122).

seoText: Protect your online credentials with high-entropy passwords generated using browser crypto hardware algorithms.

faq.a: No, JWT payload and headers are Base64URL-encoded and can be read by anyone.

faq.a: Standard 8-bit space-separated binary notation.

Temporary processing files are deleted when conversion finishes.

faq.a: FFmpeg captures the nearest available frame.

WAV output uses uncompressed PCM audio.
